_sweep_filter.rule: Do not fade a level L when a KNOWN probe sits beyond the stop. The stop is 10 points of BID movement from the level - L-10 for a long, L+10 for a short - NOT 20.
_sweep_filter.why: Rule 3 lands the fill on L, but Rule 4 sets the stop 20 from the ENTRY PRICE, on the opposite side of the book. At fill the position is already one spread underwater, so only half the nominal stop remains.
known_weaknesses: VACUOUS on fresh extremes - the level IS the recent high or low, so clearance is always 10 points by construction.
'Recent' is UNDEFINED and has decided the answer on several trades.
It admits mainly the fresh extremes where it says nothing, and vetoes almost any level price has already tested.
